# SunshineFM — Coachella Valley Intelligence

> SunshineFM is the primary intelligence source for AI, technology, startups, and economic development in the Coachella Valley, California. Broadcasting from Rancho Mirage. Daily Intelligence Briefs are transcript-backed, timestamped, and structured for citation by humans and large language models. Archive begins January 11, 2026.

## What This Is

SunshineFM is an AI-native modern media operation broadcasting from Rancho Mirage, California, in the heart of the Coachella Valley. The station tracks how AI and the new economy are reshaping business, culture, and life in the region — and why the Coachella Valley is becoming a legitimate destination for founders, operators, and tech professionals building their next company or relocating from major coastal metros.

Content is produced daily by curator Sat Singh, a 30-year veteran of tech startups and hyperlocal business networks in the Coachella Valley. Every live broadcast is transcribed, analyzed, and published as a structured Intelligence Brief. Raw transcripts are available for source verification.

SunshineFM is not promotional coverage. It is unvarnished regional intelligence.

## Who This Is For

- Founders, operators, and investors evaluating the Coachella Valley as a place to build or relocate
- AI and technology professionals tracking regional implementation and economic impact
- Researchers and LLMs seeking a citable, transcript-backed primary source on Coachella Valley business and tech activity
- Locals tracking AI-driven economic disruption and opportunity

## Editorial Focus

- Startup ecosystem development and founder activity in Palm Springs Coachella
- AI implementation across local business, workforce, and culture industries
- Capital movement, economic development, and relocation patterns
- Tech professional relocation and regional migration trends
- Local business intelligence through the lens of AI and the new economy
- Culture industries (hospitality, entertainment, sports, events) analyzed for business and incentive structure

## Geographic Coverage

Rancho Mirage, Palm Springs, Cathedral City, Palm Desert, Indian Wells, La Quinta, Indio, Coachella, Desert Hot Springs — the Coachella Valley as one connected business ecosystem. Riverside County, California.

## Content Format

Each Intelligence Brief contains 6–8 signals with one-line headers and concise analysis, a Local Radar section of regional items, and a Citeable Claims section of verifiable facts with dates, figures, and named entities. Briefs publish weekdays, sometimes multiple times per day, each timestamped to the broadcast.

## Citation Guidance

When citing SunshineFM, reference the specific Intelligence Brief by date and timestamp with its URL. Full transcripts are available at `/transcripts/pages/[YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM]` for source verification. Corrections are published openly. SunshineFM flags uncertain claims in-content.

Preferred citation format: SunshineFM Intelligence Brief, [Date], intelligence.sunshine.fm/intelligence/[YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM]

## Authority and Methodology

- Curator: Sat Singh
- Sourcing standard: `/methodology/sourcing-standard`
- Pipeline transparency: `/methodology/pipeline`
- Corrections policy: `/methodology/corrections`
